lines: The female prisoner caravan had been subjected to a surprise attack by armed refugees, who were an institution in Amidahara.
The mercenaries were desperately counterattacking, but even so, it was the other side that were in the advantageous position.
Our numbers were rapidly dwindling, with no distinction between mercenary and prisoner.
We were wiped out in no time.
The armed refugees were making unsettling war cries, like their appetites had been stimulated more than their murderous impulses.
And then, they simultaneously began to charge at us, to finish off what little resistance remained.
Bullets passed right by my ear.
While I was at a loss, it was becoming an increasingly unwinnable situation.
From the other side of the bridge, a woman came running in holding a huge sword, and sent the armed refugees' heads flying one after another.
Furthermore, from behind her, a squad of armed trolls moved in.
「I'll take care of all you guys in one go!」
The middle-aged man with the short moustache, who had doggedly remained alive, crawled out from between the corpses.
「Oh, you were alive too, huh? She's the warden of Amidahara Prison!! The trolls are low-level guards who work for her!!」
「This time, it's your turn to be eaten! I, Kaura, am gonna harvest your souls with my demonic sword!」
Kaura was swinging her big sword around left and right, with an ecstatic expression.
These weren't the movements of any swordfighting style or martial arts that I knew about. Even the ways she used her sword weren't consistent.
A clearly self-taught method. It was like she was moving in accordance with her instincts of bloodthirst and pleasure. But it sure was strong.
「Take that, and that, and that! One, two, three! Ahaha! This is fun!!」
In a flash, she cut down one, two, then three enemies.
The troll guards were well-trained too, and the cannibalistic armed refugees were no match.
They had scattered and run away in no time, as though the might of their surprise attack a moment ago had been a lie.
However, around us were a pile of bodies.
It looked like I was the one surviving captive.
「You still got the devil's own luck, huh? You do what you gotta to survive.」
Taking a glance at the man with the little moustache, who made an ingratiating smile, Kaura slowly approached me.
She was looking at me with rather joyful-seeming eyes, just like when she had cut down the armed refugees.
「Th-Thank you...... very much for saving me......」
Naturally, this was our first meeting.
But she was not unknown to me.
She was a collaborator on this mission.
Obviously, all manner of backup would be necessary for infiltrating Amidahara Prison.
One aspect of that backup was Kaura, in other words, the warden, whom we had bribed.
「Taimanin girl! The deal was that I'd help you once, but I'll make this one a freebie.」
「Got that? That means, 'side from the one time I'll help you, you and me are prisoner and warden.」
「I'm gonna be real rough on you, so look forward to it, 'kay?」
It looked like she was no simple informant, by any means.
